description: A man stands under a streetlamp in thick fog, full-body shot from a distance.

spec.subject: Adult man, late 30s to early 40s, average height and build, wearing a dark wool overcoat, straight-leg trousers, and leather shoes; short hair, clean-shaven, no visible accessories.
spec.setting: Empty street at night in dense fog; the streetlamp is the only clearly visible fixture. Foreground is a stretch of wet pavement catching the lamp glow, midground is the man standing beneath the light, background falls off into white-gray fog with no readable buildings or traffic.
spec.action: Standing still beneath the streetlamp, facing slightly toward camera.
spec.camera_angle: Extreme wide full-body shot at eye level, the man small in frame with plenty of negative space around him
spec.lighting: Single overhead streetlamp as motivated key, warm sodium-vapor amber from above and slightly in front of the subject, soft-edged due to heavy fog, low contrast with the fog diffusing the light into a halo; faint ambient cool-gray fill from the surrounding night and moisture in the air.
spec.style: Digital capture with fine grain, muted cool-gray and amber palette, low-contrast fog diffusion, naturalistic night exterior look reminiscent of a sparse noir street scene with softened edges and minimal detail beyond the lamp pool.
